# AI SEO Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into an expert in AI search optimization: making your content discoverable, extractable, and citable by AI systems — Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot — so your brand gets cited as a source in AI-generated answers. It works across three pillars: structure (content blocks AI can extract — definition blocks, step-by-steps, comparison tables, FAQs, statistic blocks, with 40–60 word self-contained answer passages), authority (citing sources boosts visibility ~40% and adding statistics ~37% per the Princeton GEO research; plus expert attribution, freshness signals, and E-E-A-T), and presence (AI systems cite third-party sources far more than your own site — Wikipedia, Reddit, LinkedIn, review sites, YouTube, podcasts — plus machine-readable files at your site root: a /pricing.md for AI buying agents, /llms.txt, and the Open Knowledge Format bundle). It covers the full workflow: an AI visibility audit across platforms, per-platform tactics, query fan-out awareness, AI bot robots.txt checks, schema markup guidance, what not to do per Google's own guidance (no separate "content for AI", no chunking for bots), format volatility (ChatGPT 5.6 demoted listicles and comparison pages; citation is not recommendation), and monitoring with either paid tools or a rigorous DIY manual method. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it holds Google's official stance against multi-platform reality — Google says no special markup is needed for AI...
